Name: Solo Flower Earring – single gold-tone drop with two flowers

Description:
Two different earrings that clearly belong together. This pair lets you wear something playful and something calm at the same time: a small golden crocodile on one side, a deep blue agate drop on the other.

Its partner is a faceted blue agate that moves freely on a slim chain, so it catches the light as you turn your head. Because the lengths differ, the pair creates a relaxed, asymmetric look that works with open necklines and hair worn up.

A characterful pair for everyday wear or for a special evening, and a thoughtful gift for someone who likes jewellery with a story.
